description: Agent Childcare Records: submit childcare credential records, one staff credential at a time (CPR and first aid certification, the child development associate credential or the director credential), with the staff record and the days relied on: the reading moment; each staff entry with its id, reference, role and the credential numbers the staff record claims; each credential with its id, reference (the credential number), kind, the staff member it is issued to, issuer and the moments issued and expiring; each reliance entry with its id, reference, the credential, the record relying on it and the day relied on. The signed report gives the credentials and the records behind them, each credential the staff record claims against the credential as issued, each credential against the days the staff or ratio record relies on it, each claimed credential against the staff member it is issued to, and each credential entry for its issuer, issue date and expiry date, and counts them, and names divergent childcare credential records: a credential the staff record claims that the credential record does not show, a credential already expired on a day relied on, a credential issued to someone other than the staff member claiming it, and a credential entry missing the issuer, the issue date or the expiry date; then a reliance entry naming a credential the record does not show and a credential that expires before it is issued, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No credential entries, or no staff record beside credentials, leaves those points unverified. Credentials, staff members and entries match by letters and digits, so CPR-4471 and CPR 4471 are one credential, dates by the day, and a credential is current through the day it expires. This reads staff credentials for childcare licensing; education credentials stay with Agent Education. Verdict childcare_credential_record_divergent, childcare_credential_record_partial, childcare_credential_record_unverified or childcare_credential_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-credential-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.

credentials.description: Each credential as issued in the childcare credential record.

holder.description: The staff member the credential is issued to reference.

kind.description: The credential kind, such as CPR and first aid certification, a child development associate credential or a director credential.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

reliance.description: Each day the staff or ratio record relies on a credential.

at.description: The day the staff or ratio record relies on the credential, such as 2026-03-02.

record.description: The record that relies on the credential, such as the childcare ratio record.

staff.description: Each staff entry with the credentials the childcare staff record claims.

credentials.description: Credential numbers the staff record claims for the staff member.
